purpose: Layer test of the EN4 and reanalysis limb contrast over 2005 to 2024, with the F_ovS change at each depth cut, and a damping check that stratifies the EN4-to-reanalysis salinity trend ratio by EN4 observation weight.

units.trends: PSU per decade (salinities), Sv per decade (transports) where stated
units.intervals: 95 per cent; trends and means from the calibrated test of paper3r1_stats

contrast_low_minus_high_weight.definition: ratio for mean observation weight < 0.5 minus ratio for weight >= 0.75 (all limb levels)
ratio for mean observation weight < 0.5 minus ratio for weight >= 0.75 (all limb levels)

damping.classification: Limb sign from the EN4 velocity frozen to the ORAS5 record mean, applied to all products; transport weights |V e3| from the same velocity.
